correction: Supersedes provisional EXP-002J_J1_NONLINEAR_TRANSFER_RESULT.json and EXP-002J2_NONLINEAR_AWARE_RESULT.json for width comparisons. The provisional reconstruction used different proposal RNG streams for width-1 and width-2. Corrected design nests breadth: width-2 contains the identical width-1 base swarm plus one independent extra swarm.
established_finding: Nonlinear-aware local likelihoods materially improve absolute recovery under nonlinear ground truth relative to linear-only inference. After correcting breadth RNG nesting, uniform width-2 is directionally beneficial under nonlinear-aware inference but remains unresolved on paired edge error at n=96; therefore the linear-benchmark breadth advantage is not yet established under model shift.
